title: Zhytomyr clinch 2025/26 League 1 title!
description: Zhytomyr - Chayka 100-91 Zhytomyr clinched 2025/26 League 1 title beating Chayka 100-91 in the Final game. Trailing 21-28 at the end of the first quarter, Zhytomyr replied with a 27-17 run in the second frame and produced a marvellous 34-21 third quarter to win the game. Chayka won the last stanza 25-18 but could not catch up with the winners. Vadim Dovidniy (184-G-1993) led the winners with 29 points and Oleksandr Shepelev (201-F-1994) netted 25. Igor Starodub (182-PG-1997) and Tischenko netted 18 points each in a loss.
